note:
3641 -> 3370, and not one file was formatted: `is_formattable` stops selecting fixtures. 281 of the XML files this gate walked live under a tests/ directory and 271 of them were unformatted -- 7.4% of a floor that could never legitimately be paid, because canonicalising a fixture changes what its test asserts. l10n_it_edi/tests/import_xmls/IT01234567889_FPR03.xml is the clearest case: a deliberately malformed EDI sample that does not parse at all, which four XML gates were dropping in silence.

Verified before excluding them: no manifest names a data or demo file under tests/, so nothing that loads is lost. `TestFixerScope.test_no_fixture_directory_is_selected_as_data` holds the selection, and `PrettyXmlLinter.test_no_data_file_is_unparseable` turns the silent drop into a failure.
